blocks.html:
Ford Transit Connect Commercial Van Decals

When you want to advertise your business or products, one of the best and most effective ways to do it is via the help of decals that go on the surface of your vehicle to be seen by people when you’re on the road. Our recent client wanted to get some vinyl decals and lettering on his Ford Transit Connect Minivan. The purpose was simply to promote their business.

The client chose to get decals and lettering for his Ford Transit Connect based on the following factors:

  1. Van Decals and Lettering allow you to be creative without design limitations; as long as it can be designed, we can turn it into decals or lettering and install it on your vehicle.
  2. For decals and lettering, you get to pick from a wide spectrum of colours.
  3. You can pick from a number of available finish styles such as satin, gloss, matte, etc.
  4. It is a non-aggressive way to advertise because you’re not interrupting anyone to show them your ad.
  5. Van decals last for years, meaning you don’t have to pay those daily/weekly/monthly campaign charges that you would normally do on an online ads campaign.
  6. Cost-effective considering the lifetime and minimal maintenance.
  7. You turn the vehicle into a moving Billboard

The customer wanted to go for something very simple, which is to get commercial decals all around his Ford Transit Connect Van. Decals including his company logo, slogan, contact number and website. The client consulted with our team and we were more than happy to take in the job.

For the decals, we used Avery Dennison’s printable vinyl and laminate. We only use what we consider to be the best quality material available on the market which is Avery Dennison & 3M. The design called for the decals to go on both sides, the hood and the back of the Ford Transit Connect. Installing these decals was no big deal for our expert installers. We have attached pictures of the Ford Transit Connect on this page for you to see what the van decals look ended up looking like.

We knew the client was happy with our service because he also placed an order to get custom branded corporate apparel done by Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s partner Workwear Toronto.

Over the years, we’ve installed decals and wrapped a lot of these Ford Transit Connect vans. Each one of them has a different style of decals that helped them stand out.

If you have a Ford Transit Connect or any vehicle that you want to use to advertise your business, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our showroom located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts about your requirements or vinyl wrap cost.

See more articles on our blog page. Check out more van decals here.
